task: On Allrecipes, find a vegan brownie recipe that has at least 40 reviews and a rating of 4.5 or higher. Include the list of ingredients, total prep and cook time, and a brief overview of the preparation steps.
answer: Found the 'Vegan Brownies' recipe on Allrecipes (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/68436/vegan-brownies/). Rating: 4.6 (978 ratings, 835 reviews — exceeds the 4.5 rating and 40 review thresholds). Ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour; 2 cups granulated white sugar; ¾ cup good-quality unsweetened cocoa powder, sifted; 1 teaspoon baking powder; ¾ teaspoon salt; 1 cup hot water or coffee; ½ cup vegetable oil; 2 teaspoons vanilla extract. Times: Prep 15 mins, Cook 30 mins, Total 55 mins. Preparation overview: (1) Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9x13-inch dish; (2) Whisk flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl; (3) Add water/coffee, oil, and vanilla; mix until blended and spread in dish; (4) Bake about 30 minutes until top is no longer shiny and center feels just set; (5) Cool at least 10 minutes before cutting into 15 squares.
